method: Built-in image_gen, followed by System.Drawing format/size conversion
scope: Three icon candidates and a Korean standalone HTML guide. After supplemental publication for v0.5.1, the user selected icon01 for embedding into the v0.5.2 EXE. Previous release assets are preserved.

icon01.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a single production-quality Windows application/release-file icon for a Korean education-administration app named "민원답변 도우미" (complaint-response writing assistant).
Primary request: create one elegant, instantly legible app icon expressing a written response and careful review, consistent with the existing app's forest-teal palette and simple document-shaped speech-bubble brand.
Design: a rich forest teal (#136859, deep shade #0c5145) rounded-square tile, centered on a genuinely transparent canvas. On the tile place a large warm ivory speech bubble that also reads as a sheet of paper, with two bold short teal horizontal lines inside. At its lower-right edge, a compact light mint circular badge containing a strong deep-teal checkmark. The bubble has a clear small lower-left tail. All parts should have generous spacing and bold silhouettes, recognizable at 32 and 48 pixels.
Style: polished contemporary desktop productivity icon, almost-flat vector-like geometry with restrained soft dimensional shading and clean precision edges. Calm, trustworthy, professional, distinctive. Front view.
Composition: square 1024x1024 image, one isolated icon only, tile occupies about 90% of the canvas with consistent transparent outer margins and unclipped corners. No background beyond the tile, no scene, no pedestal, no cast shadow outside the tile.
Text: none.
Constraints: actual alpha transparency outside the rounded tile; no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark, no mockup, no sample grid, no extra sparkles, no tiny details, no government seal.
icon01.edit: Remove exterior neon flecks and colored edge halos; preserve the design and transparency.
